Index construction, table access, caching and disk I/O are excluded.
索引需要额外空间；插入、更新、删除时还要维护索引，增加写入代价。二分查找不代表所: An index uses extra space and needs maintenance on inserts, updates and deletes, adding write cost. Binary search does not make every query faster; a sequential scan may find the target first.
